messages:
elda: dropping a quick threadabout export formats for traces. question: should export default to JSON or include CSV option?
frank: JSON feels like the canonical one since traces have nested spans and metadata. CSV will lose structure.
mira: +1 JSON default. but support sometimes needs a flat table for analysis in sheets. maybe export presets: JSON (full), CSV (flattened), and Small JSON (no payloads).
jess: accessibility note: for exported files, we need to ensure the download is announced via live region and that file names are descriptive for screen reader users.
kai: technical constraints: we already have async export job that zips results. adding CSV flattening is additional compute but doable as an opt-in flag.
elda: on filename: current auto-name is "trace_export.zip" which is too generic. propose pattern: "trace-<trace_id>-<env>-<ts>.zip" (e.g., trace-7f3b2-prod-20260201.zip).
mira: love that. also add a metadata manifest inside the zip: manifest.json with export options, model, user, filters used. Helps reproducibility.
frank: UX question: where to surface export options? inline dropdown next to export button or modal with checkboxes?
jess: modal is better for accessibility because keyboard users can tab through options and screen readers get context. inline dropdown might be harder to navigate.
kai: modal also lets us show estimated size/time for the export. we can show a spinner and then send a notification link.
uxbot: accessibility scan: ensure modal has role=dialog, focus trap, and an accessible close button. also ensure export option checkboxes have labels.
frank: quick mock idea: export primary button opens modal with three radio presets (Full JSON, Flattened CSV, Minimal JSON) and an "Advanced" toggle to pick fields.
mira: copy wording nits: replace "Flattened CSV" with "CSV (table format)" and "Minimal JSON" -> "JSON (no payloads)". clarity helps non-technical folks.
jess: also call out that IDs in CSV should not be truncated visually or in the file. UI can show truncated but copy/downloaded file must contain full ids.
leda: typo: "+1" should be "+1" :)
kai: about correlation IDs: UI currently truncates long ids with ellipsis visually. we should add a copy button on hover that copies the full id and have an aria-describedby that announces "Full correlation ID copied".
mira: good. also debatable: should the exported manifest include source maps or original logs? privacy concerns. default: do not include raw logs unless checkbox checked and user has permission.
frank: permission check is important. add a note in modal: "You may need export permission to include raw logs." and gray out those options.
jess: keyboard shortcuts: suggestion to add "E" for export open modal; when modal open, pressing Enter triggers primary export. ensure conflict-free mapping (avoid E on text fields).
uxbot: accessibility scan: contrast on modal confirm button currently fails 3:1 for disabled state. ensure disabled state meets 4.5:1.
leda: small copy change for notification message: instead of "Export ready", use "Trace export ready: Click to download" to be more actionable.
mira: action items: 1) design to create modal mock with presets + advanced fields + filename pattern (mira). 2) eng to implement manifest.json and filename pattern + async toast with aria-live announce (kai). 3) security to review privacy flags for logs (frank). 4) a11y to re-run scan on the modal (jess). I'll post updated frames and example manifest schema.
jess: final a11y ask: when user chooses CSV, we should include header descriptions in first row like "span_id (hex)", so screen reader users loading it in spreadsheets get context.
kai: noted. thanks all. I'll slot work in next sprint and estimate CSV flattening as a microservice task (1-2 wk).
frank: tagging customer ops for feedback on filename pattern and export presets.
mira: thanks team 44d will upload mocks by EOD and mark for crit review next Tue.
